profiles.versions: Record the tested modern versions at execution; none is prescribed by the source.
profiles.requiredEvidence: Rendered interaction observations for the same cases; a presentation model alone is insufficient.
Review rendered layouts and complete the same user journeys in both view classes. Confirm chosen breakpoints, orientations and device scope.

Observe localized navigation, forms, outcomes and errors while preserving animal identity and role restrictions. Agree translation ownership for animal/attribute descriptions, fallback behavior and additional languages.

profiles.scope: Entire delivered web experience, including authentication handoffs, public-facing personal experiences, biologist sections and applicable offline states.
profiles.requiredEvidence: An assessment against every applicable WCAG 2.1 Level A and Level AA success criterion, with the tested scope, versions, method and findings retained. Automated results alone or a returned compliant=true flag are not a conformance claim.

profiles.registeredUserPopulation: tens of thousands; choose and record an exact test population
profiles.requiredEvidence: A measured run with a declared workload mix, dataset, ramp, duration, think time and infrastructure profile. Measure read/write latency, failures, queues and resource use; prove collection isolation, field restrictions, team maximum and encounter integrity still hold. Do not reinterpret 2000 concurrent users as 2000 requests per second.

After owner approval, demonstrate disconnected capture, photo retention across reload, reconnect synchronization, interrupted upload, lost acknowledgment and wrong-account refusal on each supported target.
